WITH client_account_links AS (
    SELECT d.client_id, d.account_id, dist.A3 AS region
    FROM disp AS d
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = d.account_id
    JOIN district AS dist ON dist.district_id = a.district_id
), region_counts AS (
    SELECT region, COUNT(*) AS client_count
    FROM client_account_links
    GROUP BY region
), region_shares AS (
    SELECT region, client_count,
           CAST(client_count AS REAL) / SUM(client_count) OVER () AS share
    FROM region_counts
), summary AS (
    SELECT SUM(client_count) AS total_count,
           AVG(share) AS average_share,
           AVG(share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM region_shares)) AS average_excess_share
    FROM region_shares
    WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM region_shares)
)
SELECT total_count, average_share, average_excess_share
FROM summary;

assumptions.assumption: Each disp row represents one client-account link, so multiple disposition rows for the same client and account are counted separately if present. Shares are calculated over regions represented by at least one such link.
